['Edeka Handelsgesellschaft S\u00fcdwest.company_description: The Edeka Group is the largest German supermarket corporation, consisting of several co-operatives of independent supermarkets operating under the umbrella organization Edeka Zentrale AG & Co KG. It has approximately 4,100 stores with the Edeka nameplate, ranging from small corner stores to hypermarkets. Additionally, Edeka reached an agreement with Tengelmann to purchase a 70% majority stake in Tengelmann's Plus discounter store division, which was then merged into Edeka's Netto brand, resulting in around 4,200 stores by 2018. Netto Marken-Discount, owned by the Edeka Group, is a German discount supermarket chain that operates mostly in the south and west of Germany.
